evidence: HfO2 thin films were grown at temperatures between 250 and 400 1C by atomic layer deposition using novel cyclopentadienyl–alkylamido precursors, namely CpHf(NMe2)3 and (CpMe)Hf(NMe2)3... Ozone was used as the oxygen source. Nitrogen ( 499.999%, NITROX UHPN 3000 N2 generator) was used as a carrier and purging gas.
